description: Multi-model comparison across 3 visual conditions for 2 figures

conditions.clean: Isolated figure image only, no caption/title
conditions.in_paper: Full paper page with figure number hint
conditions.fig_blurred: Paper page with figure blurred out, only text readable

key_findings: All models handle clean isolated images well
In-paper pages: Qwen family handles well, Gemma family struggles especially on Chinese
Figure-blurred reveals honesty gap: frontier models admit uncertainty, small models hallucinate confidently
Gemma architecture hallucinates at both 4B and 27B (same failure mode)
Qwen-8B outperforms Gemma-27B on complex multi-element pages
Model family/architecture matters as much as model size
Captions bias descriptions: image-only scores higher than image+caption
